plants.defect: For an ignored member the non-public flag is combined with &= instead of |=, so it can never become true there and ignored non-public members no longer count towards serializing non-public members.
The check that a keyed member is non-public is inverted (== Public instead of != Public), so a keyed non-public member no longer marks non-public members as serialized.
Deferred diagnostics for non-public members are reported only when both nonPublicMembersAreSerialized and AllowPrivate hold (&&), instead of when either does.

The deserializing constructor is picked by ascending parameter count (ThenBy) instead of descending (ThenByDescending), so with several equally accessible constructors the one with the fewest parameters wins.
The nullable-annotation filter matches formatters whose type argument is already annotated (NullableAnnotation.Annotated) instead of those that are not (NotAnnotated).
The symbol switch collects [MessagePackObject] types only when they are classes (case TypeKind.Class); structs, including record structs, are no longer analysed.
The inaccessible-formatter diagnostic is reported only for formatters excluded from the source-generated resolver (the negation was dropped), instead of for those included in it.
The UntrustedData preset sets HashCollisionResistant = false instead of true, so data deserialized as untrusted uses the default equality comparer.

GetEqualityComparer<T> uses the collision-resistant comparer only for types other than string (&& typeof(T) != typeof(string)), so string keys fall back to the default equality comparer even when HashCollisionResistant is on.
DepthStep throws only when the depth is greater than the maximum (>) instead of when it reaches it (>=), so MaximumObjectGraphDepth + 1 levels of nesting are accepted.

perPlant.statement: The change also adds a new analyzer diagnostic, MsgPack023, that warns when a member's type comes from a referenced assembly.
The new helper falls back to the location of the containing type when the property has no source declaration.
Diagnostics whose location is outside the compilation being analysed are now reported with no location instead of being dropped, so the consuming project still sees them.
A member with a mismatched key kind is skipped before its diagnostic is reported.
Generic types are supported as long as every type argument is closed.
